## Observed behavior
The scheduled Dependency Refresh job fails during `npm run release:check` because the test gate requires Bun, while this job only sets up Node.

- [2026-10-19 run 39226644176, job 117974435386](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/39226644176/job/117974435386), checkout `7609e6c6198010bd7c7971a01d015ddec8d0ca62`
- 1,667 tests: 1,662 pass, 2 fail, 3 skip
- The packed conflicted-change CLI test fails with `spawnSync bun ENOENT`
- The packed global served CLI Bun test fails with `Bun is required on CI`
- The job stops before the dependency-refresh PR creation step

The same missing-runtime prerequisite already failed in the [2026-10-12 job 114778470548](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/38239545329/job/114778470548) on an earlier checkout. That run had a different suite size and one different failing Bun consumer test, but the same ENOENT and explicit CI-required failure signatures. This is a recurring blocker, not evidence that the October 19 change introduced it.

## Configuration
[dependency-refresh.yml at the captured head](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7609e6c6198010bd7c7971a01d015ddec8d0ca62/.github/workflows/dependency-refresh.yml#L28-L56) installs Node 22 and runs the release gate without setting up Bun.

## Expected result
Provision the supported Bun runtime before this job executes the unchanged release gate. Preserve the gate's required Bun coverage and failure behavior.

## Acceptance
- The refresh job explicitly provisions the supported Bun runtime before release checks
- The existing Bun-required-in-CI checks execute with Bun available; no missing-runtime failures, new skip conditions, or weakened assertions
- Verification identifies the exact candidate head and separately records the release-gate result; clearing this prerequisite alone does not prove every later gate or PR-event requirement is fixed

## Scope and related work
The canonical certification work is [pm-vcs-bcgs, currently blocked](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7609e6c6198010bd7c7971a01d015ddec8d0ca62/.agents/pm/chores/pm-vcs-bcgs.toon). Its SDK/dispatch scope does not record this missing-runtime blocker. [pm-vcs-17li, closed](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7609e6c6198010bd7c7971a01d015ddec8d0ca62/.agents/pm/issues/pm-vcs-17li.toon) owns the original self-host bundle/dependency-refresh work.

[pm-vcs-dispatch104](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/7609e6c6198010bd7c7971a01d015ddec8d0ca62/.agents/pm/issues/pm-vcs-dispatch104.toon) tracks the later issue of which workflow events satisfy required PR checks. This blocker occurs earlier, before a refresh PR exists.

Read-only diagnosis used the existing job logs and exact workflow bytes. No workflow rerun, dependency install, implementation change, or release was performed.
